$comment: P6.1 building archetypes + G1 architectural contract (frozen 2026-11-25 for house_small, house_large, ruko, warkop_open). Runtime reads facade/depth/roof/yard/entrance; `contract` is the art/engine agreement (docs/production/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT_G1.md). Silhouette differences come from width, height, depth and roof — never tint alone.

house_small.use: narrow single-storey home in a gang

collision.note: physical footprint = width × depth behind the front line; never the alpha bbox of the art

depthSort.roofLayer: y + 0.01 (drawn over the facade's top edge it overlaps)
depthSort.addOns: y + 0.02 unless they stand in front of the front line, then their own ground y
depthSort.occlusion: front + roof fade together when Zila is behind the building

front.covers: everything from the ground up to the eave/fascia line on the front plane: walls, doors, windows, columns, signs
front.pivotMeaning: bottom-centre of the front line (ground y = placement y)

roof.covers: the whole roof mass as seen in ZsRoom's 3/4 projection (depth × 0.7): near slope, ridge, far slope, gable ends, overhangs; porch roof included
roof.pivotMeaning: front eave line, centre (render y = front line × 0.7 − eave)

contract.notes: G1 small A, re-proportioned: 420 wide, door 90×210 (was ~176 high).
